quests.title: Goku's Tail Trouble!
quests.summary: A Corrupted Kid Goku is wrecking Kame House. Roshi wants him stopped before the moon comes out.

brief.text: Ah, you must be the new recruit! Good timing. A little boy with a monkey tail showed up this morning and wrecked my house!
It's Goku. Well, Goku from back when he was a kid. He's glowing purple and shouting that he's the strongest.
I'm coming too. Kid Goku was tough even back then. Aw, man... I can't believe I have to fight him again.
And {name}, whatever you do, don't let him look at the full moon! Trust me on this one.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Kame House, at sunset. The moon is starting to rise over the sea.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Hey, are you strong? You look strong! Grandpa's voice says I gotta beat everybody, so I'm gonna beat you!

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Grandpa's voice? Goku, your grandpa died a long time ago!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Something's talking to him. Let's snap him out of it before the moon gets any higher.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Okay, here I come! Rock, paper... nah, forget it! I'm just gonna punch you!

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The Great Ape falls into the sea and shrinks back into a sleepy little boy.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Huh? Why's the beach all wrecked? ...Did I do that? Sorry, mister.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Phew... He saw the moon and turned into that giant ape again. I forgot how scary that was.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: There was a voice in the fog. It sounded like Grandpa, but meaner. It said my tail makes me special.

win.speaker: player
win.text: A voice in the fog that sounds like his grandpa... I'll keep an eye out.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Hehe! I win! Hey, you got any food? I'm starving!

after.text: Well done! Kame House is still standing... mostly. That's pretty good for a visit from Goku.
But that 'Grandpa voice' worries me. Gohan was the kindest man I ever trained. Someone is using his memory to fool the boy.

quests.title: Grandpa Gohan Returns
quests.summary: Grandpa Gohan has come back from the Other World with violet eyes. Roshi wants to know who brought him back.

brief.text: Fortuneteller Baba called. One of her fighters went missing from her palace. Gohan. My old student, and Goku's grandfather.
He's been dead for a long time, {name}. And now he's wandering around Mount Paozu, looking for his grandson.
The Malice comes from the machine in Hell. Maybe it's pulling the dead back too.
Then go bring him back, but be gentle. He's the one who taught Goku to be kind. Don't let the Malice turn him cruel.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Mount Paozu. An old man with a halo stands in the violet mist.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: You've come to take me back. I won't go. I was promised more time. The years with Goku that I never got.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Promised by who?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: A kind voice, in a black mist. It said a man who loved so much deserved to live again. So why does it hurt?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Forgive me, child. The Turtle School's Four Virtues... I can't remember a single one.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Ah... the fog is lifting. I can see my old house. I can see where Goku used to sleep.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: That voice wasn't kind at all. It was hungry. And it kept laughing the whole time it spoke.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Did you see who it was?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: He was small, with pointed ears. He looked young, but his eyes were old. And he smelled like stagnant water.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Tell Roshi I'm sorry. And Goku... no, don't tell him. I want him to remember me smiling.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Stay down, child. I only want what that voice promised me.

after.text: Black mist and stagnant water... I heard about something like that long ago. Kami would know. He never liked to talk about it.
Gohan's safe back at Baba's. I told him you had a good heart. He said, 'Then you can't have been the one training them!' The nerve!

quests.title: The Demon King Returns!
quests.summary: Demon King Piccolo has broken out of his seal and taken over King's Castle. Roshi is going full power.

brief.text: Now that we know Garlic Jr. is behind all this, there's something I should tell you. I know a thing or two about seals. The Mafuba.
My master Mutaito gave his life to seal Demon King Piccolo inside a rice cooker. Now the Malice has broken it open.
So what's the plan?
The plan is, I get serious. Full power! ...Don't look at me like that. I'm still a martial arts master, you know.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: King's Castle. The throne room roof is gone, and Demon King Piccolo is sitting on the throne.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Well, if it isn't Mutaito's old student. You look so frail, old man. Did you come to beg for mercy?

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Hohoho. No, I came to put you back in that rice cooker! Haaaaaa!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: This violet power belongs to a little prince who thinks he owns me. Let him think that. Then I'll crush him too.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Garlic Jr. can't even control his own monsters. Let's finish this!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: This fog... It was controlling me. I was just someone else's puppet. Unforgivable!

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Mutaito gave his life for that seal. I won't let it go to waste. Your days of terror are over, Piccolo.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Laugh while you can, old man. No seal lasts forever. Garlic got out of the Dead Zone, didn't he? Every prison opens someday.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Then we'll be waiting when it does. That's what the Turtle School is for.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Pathetic. Is this the best the Turtle School has left?

after.text: Whew! My back... my knees... I'm getting too old for this. Still, I've got a few lessons left in me, and you've earned them.
Come train at Kame House any time. Oh, and bring some magazines. For, uh... morale!

quests.title: Gohan Runs Away!
quests.summary: Little Gohan has run off into the woods glowing purple, and he still hasn't finished his math homework.

brief.text: You're the Patrol rookie? Good! My Gohan ran into the forest this morning, and his eyes were PURPLE! He left his math book on the table!
First Piccolo kidnaps him, and now some fog from Hell thinks it can take my son? Not on my watch!
That might be Gohan from years ago. The Malice pulls people out of the past.
Then young Gohan has homework too! Bring him home, {name}. Gently! And then tell him to sit down at his desk.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Mount Paozu, by the river. Little Gohan is glowing violet, and he looks very angry.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: I'm not going back! Mom makes me study, and Mr. Piccolo makes me train, and nobody asks what I want!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Gohan, calm down. Your mom's worried about you.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: The fog says I'm the strongest one in my family. It says I should make everybody stop bossing me around!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: If that's how it's gonna be, then show me what you've got!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: I... I yelled at Mom. In my head, I said such mean things to her.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: I'm sorry. I don't even hate studying. I just want to be a scholar AND protect everybody.

win.speaker: player
win.text: You can do both. Come on, your mom's waiting. So is your math book.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Oh no... She's gonna be so mad.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: See? I don't need anybody telling me what to do!

after.text: He's home, he's crying, and he's doing his fractions. Perfect! Thank you, {name}.
If you ever see purple fog near my house again, you come get me. I've got a frying pan, and I'm not afraid to use it!

quests.title: Two Gokus, One Promise
quests.summary: Two young Gokus are fighting each other in the valley, and neither of them remembers Chichi.

brief.text: There are TWO Gokus out in the valley! One looks like when we got married, the other like when he came back from King Kai's. Both purple!
They're fighting each other and laughing! And when I called out to them, the younger one asked me who I was!
He promised to marry me at the World Tournament! He doesn't get to forget that just because some fog told him to!
Don't worry. I'll knock some sense into them.
Good. That's the only way he ever learns anything.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A valley below Mount Paozu, at sunset. Two Gokus from different years are fighting each other.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Hey, a new challenger! The fog says if I beat everybody, I'll never have to stop fighting. Sounds great!

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: You look pretty tough. Don't hold back, okay? 'Cause I'm gonna use the Kaio-ken!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Chichi says hi. And you missed dinner. For a whole week.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Chichi...? That name feels warm. But the fog says warm things make you weak.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Ow... That knocked the purple right out of my head. Huh. Man, I'm starving.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Chichi! I promised to marry her at the tournament! I remember now! Aw jeez, she's gonna kill me.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Probably. But she'll feed you first.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: The fog kept saying fighting is all I am. That's not true. I fight so I can come home after.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: That was fun! C'mon, get up, let's go again! ...Hey, how come you're not getting up?

after.text: They ate eleven bowls of rice each, then fell asleep on the porch. Some things even the Malice can't change. Thank you, {name}.

quests.title: Gohan's Rage
quests.summary: Teen Gohan is stuck in Super Saiyan 2 and attacking anyone who gets close. Chichi wants her boy back.

brief.text: I never wanted him to fight Cell. Nobody listened to me! And now teenage Gohan is out there with his hair standing up, glowing purple.
They say he attacks anyone who gets near him. That's not my boy. My boy cries when he steps on a bug!
The Malice feeds on anger. And he had a lot of it at the Cell Games.
Then you find my boy under all that anger, and you bring him home. Promise me, {name}.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Cell Games Arena. Teen Gohan stands in the middle, sparks running through his violet aura.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Another one who wants me to fight? Fine. I'm done holding back. Holding back is what got my dad killed.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Your mom sent me. She doesn't want you to fight.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Mom... She was right. She was always right. And I went anyway. So what does that make me?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Don't answer that. Just come at me! I want to see how much stronger I've gotten!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: I can't stay angry... Every time I try, I see Mom's face.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: The fog said my power belongs to everyone who needs saving. That I'm a weapon, and a weapon never gets put away.

win.speaker: player
win.text: You're not a weapon, Gohan. You're a person. And you get to go home.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: ...Can you take me back? I don't think I can fly straight right now.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Stay down. I don't want to hurt you anymore... I just can't stop!

after.text: He told me he was sorry about the Cell Games. It took him years, but I'll take it. Thank you, {name}. Really.

quests.title: Chichi Joins the Fight!
quests.summary: Goku's Super Saiyan rage from Namek has hit Mount Paozu. Chichi is coming with you, and that's final.

brief.text: I saw him from the window. Goku, the angry golden one from Namek. He looked at our house like it was Frieza!
I'm coming with you, and don't you argue! I fought in the World Tournament too, you know.
Chichi, he's a Super Saiyan!
And I'm his WIFE! Super Saiyan or not, he's going to listen to me, {name}.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Mount Paozu. Goku's golden aura, streaked with violet, is bending the trees back.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Frieza... Where are you hiding? I'll make you pay for Krillin! I'll make you ALL pay!

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Goku! You look at me! There's no Frieza here! Just my laundry, and you're getting mud all over it!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Get out of my way! Don't make me hurt you too!

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Hurt me? I'd like to see you try! {name}, you take the left. I'm grabbing his ear!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Chi... Chichi? Ow... Was that a frying pan? Why does my head hurt so much?

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Because I hit you with it! You scared me half to death, you big dummy!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: I was back on Namek. Everybody was gone. The fog made it feel like it was still happening, over and over.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: It's over, Goku. It's been over for years. Now come home. Dinner's getting cold, and that's your fault too!

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: I said get out of my way! I won't stop until Frieza's gone!

after.text: Now I'll teach you how I fight, {name}. It's not pretty, but it works.
Goku says I hit harder than Vegeta. Well, Vegeta never had to raise two Saiyans!

quests.title: Yamcha's Rematch!
quests.summary: Saibamen are sprouting all over the Wasteland. Yamcha has a score to settle, but he wants backup.

brief.text: Hey, rookie! Got a minute? A bunch of Saibamen are popping out of the ground over by the canyon. Purple ones.
You might not know this, but a Saibaman once... Look, never mind. It used a cheap trick. Self-destruct! So dirty!
Didn't it kill you?
Only for a little while! Anyway, you go first, and I'll be right behind you. Way behind you. For strategy!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Wasteland. Saibamen are crawling out of the ground, glowing violet.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Kkkee! Kkkehehehe!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Yamcha, they're laughing at you. ...Yamcha?

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Great. He's hiding behind a rock. Looks like it's just me, then.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Kkkkeeeee!

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The last Saibaman falls, and the violet glow fades.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Kke... kkee...

win.speaker: player
win.text: These didn't just grow here. Someone planted them. In nice, straight rows.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Kkkehehehe! Kkkee!

after.text: Nice! I mean, I totally had that, but nice! ...Wait, rows? Saibamen don't grow in rows. Somebody's farming them!

quests.title: Nappa's Saibaman Farm
quests.summary: Yamcha followed the Saibamen back to their farmer: Nappa, Corrupted and very proud of his crop.

brief.text: I found the farmer. Big bald guy, mustache, huge. He's watering Saibamen with a tiny watering can. And humming!
It's Nappa. He's the guy who... look, that's another bad memory. I've got a lot of those, okay? That's life on the front line.
You were on the front line?
I was on A line! Anyway, go get him. I'll stay here and... guard the area. Yeah.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A field of Saibaman sprouts in neat rows. Nappa kneels between them with a tiny watering can.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Hey, watch it! You're stepping on my sprouts! You know how hard it is to grow these on this dirtball planet?

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Why are you growing Saibamen?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: The fog says an army's coming, and I get to be its general. Vegeta never let me be general!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Bah, enough talk! Time to wipe you out!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Ugh. Lost to a nobody again. Vegeta's gonna laugh at me...

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: The fog talked about an army. Everyone in Hell who ever got pushed around. Some little guy was making promises to all of them.

win.speaker: player
win.text: A little guy?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Never saw him. Just heard him. Squeaky voice, big words, and a really annoying laugh. Hey, can I keep the watering can?

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Hah! You'll make good fertilizer! Hey, that's actually a great idea!

after.text: An army of thugs from Hell. Okay. Okay, that's fine. I'm fine. Everything's fine.
Hey, {name}... ever feel like everyone's getting stronger except you? No? Ha! Me neither. Forget I said anything.

quests.title: Yamcha's Dark Side
quests.summary: Yamcha wants to meet you alone in the Wasteland at midnight. He says he's finally figured it all out.

brief.text: {name}. Come to the Wasteland tonight. Just you. Don't tell Krillin. Don't tell anybody.
I figured it out. Why I always lose. Why everyone leaves me behind. It's not my fault. It never was.
Yamcha, your eyes... They're purple.
Ha! Ha ha. You're seeing things. Tonight. Alone.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Wasteland at midnight. Yamcha sits on the rock where he used to wait for travelers in his bandit days.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: You came. Good. You're the only one who treats me like I matter, you know that?

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Yamcha, the Malice has got you. Snap out of it!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: It found me after the fight with Nappa. It said, 'You were Goku's first friend, and they left you behind.' And it's right!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Goku. Krillin. Tien. Even Chiaotzu! I'm done being the joke. Come on, {name}! Wolf Fang Fist!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Oh no. Oh no, no, no. What did I say? Tell me I didn't say all that out loud.

win.speaker: player
win.text: You did. But you also fought better than I've ever seen you fight.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: ...Really? Huh. I'm not sure that's a compliment, but I'll take it.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: That voice knew everything about me. The desert, the bandit days, all of it. Whoever's behind this knows all of us.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Who's the one left behind now, huh? WHO?!

after.text: So, uh... Can we keep this one between us? Please don't tell Krillin.
I'll teach you the Wolf Fang Fist. For real this time. Trust me, I know a lot about getting back up after you get knocked down.

quests.title: The Assassin Tao Pai Pai
quests.summary: Tao Pai Pai has taken a contract to kill Tien, and the client paid him in strange black coins.

brief.text: Tao Pai Pai is in the Rocky Area. The world's greatest assassin, and my old master's brother. He's here for me.
I'd face him alone, but he's glowing like the others. And the Patrol could use the experience.
Why does he want you dead?
He's an assassin. Someone paid him. Find out who, {name}. I've made a lot of enemies. I want to know which one it is.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Rocky Area. Tao Pai Pai stands on top of a stone pillar, waiting.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Hmph. A child. They send a child to stand between me and my money? How insulting.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Who hired you to kill Tien?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: A professional never names his client. But this one paid in advance, and gave me this power as a bonus.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Don't worry. I won't charge extra for killing you too.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Impossible! Beaten again... This violet haze has clouded my mind.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Fine. The client was short and wore a cloak. He talked like a spoiled prince. He paid in black coins that rusted in the sunlight.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Black coins?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: They had a star stamped on them that I've never seen in any sky. I'll take any contract. But I didn't like taking that one.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Hmph. Too easy. I'll add your funeral to the client's bill.

after.text: A strange star, and coins that rust in the sun. That's not one of my old enemies. It's something worse.
Thank you, {name}. I won't forget this.

quests.title: Chiaotzu's Silence
quests.summary: Chiaotzu's voice in Tien's head has gone quiet. Now Cyborg Tao is back, with Chiaotzu at his side.

brief.text: Chiaotzu and I can talk with our minds. We always have. Three days ago, his voice stopped.
Last night, a voice came back. But it wasn't him. It was whispering in a language I don't know.
Then Tao Pai Pai showed up with him. The cyborg one. He wants revenge. Please, {name}. I want my friend back.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Rocky Area at night. Cyborg Tao stands beside Chiaotzu, whose eyes are shut tight.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Tien sent his pet? Oh well. I'll practice on you first. I need to test my new body.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: ...Tien? No. Not Tien. The voice says Tien always leaves me behind. He left me behind against Nappa.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Chiaotzu, that voice is lying to you!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Of course it's lying. But it promised me Tien's head and a body that will never rust. That's good enough for me.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Tien? Tien! I can hear him again! He's yelling... and crying a little.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Bah! That thing only wanted my grudge. It used my pride and gave me nothing!

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: The whispers were in some really old language. Maybe Kami knows it. It sounded like a curse.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Do you remember any of the words?

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Just one. 'Makyo.' It kept saying it over and over, like it was proud of it.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Go away! I'll make you stop moving! I'm good at that!

after.text: Makyo. I asked Roshi about it. He went quiet and told me some things are better left alone.
Chiaotzu is sleeping now. He keeps waking up to ask if I'm still there. I'll be there every time.

quests.title: Tien's Neo Tri-Beam!
quests.summary: Tambourine is hunting World Tournament fighters by name. Tien is next on his list, and he'll be ready.

brief.text: Tambourine. Demon King Piccolo's son. He killed Krillin years ago. Now he's back with a list of names from the Tournament.
My name is next. Then Chiaotzu's. I'm done waiting. We fight him together, {name}.
You've been training something new, haven't you?
The Neo Tri-Beam. If I fall, you finish him. If I win, you'll see it up close. Either way, you learn something.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Rocky Area at noon. Tambourine sits on a boulder, reading a crumpled tournament list.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Tien Shinhan. Three eyes, Crane School. The list says you're next. And the list is never wrong.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Your father is gone, Tambourine. Garlic Jr. is just using you. Walk away.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Garlic? That runt thinks he controls me. I hunt for my own clan. His power just makes it more fun.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Then you'll fall for your clan. {name}, I'll start with the Tri-Beam. Don't let him get past us!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Bah... The fog is gone, and so is my appetite. How boring.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Garlic Jr. hands out power to anyone who'll take it. And everyone who takes it ends up working for him.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Not all of it is his, Crane. That filth from Hell has a mind of its own now. It laughs when he isn't looking.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: ...Remember that, {name}. Now let's go get some tea. My hands won't stop shaking.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Another name crossed off. Who's next? Ah, yes. The little pale one.

after.text: You've earned the Crane School's lessons. Not the third eye, though. You have to be born with that.
I was an assassin once, {name}. The Malice keeps trying to remind me. Training you is how I answer it.

quests.title: Pilaf's Evil Dam!
quests.summary: The river below Namu's village has stopped flowing. Upstream, someone built a dam with Pilaf's face on it.

brief.text: You are the Patrol's new warrior? Forgive me for bothering you. My village lives off the river on this mountain. Yesterday it stopped.
I followed it upstream. There is a steel wall across it. And on the wall is a face. A small, blue, very smug face.
That sounds like Emperor Pilaf.
I do not know any emperors. I only know that the children of my village are drinking from puddles. Will you come?

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Mountain Road. Pilaf's robot stands on top of a dam, waving a flag with his face on it.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Behold! The Pilaf Reservoir! Every drop of water on this mountain now belongs to the future ruler of the world!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: You're stealing water from a village!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Stealing? It's called business! Once they're thirsty enough, they'll pay anything! Mai! Shu! Attack!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Aaah! The controls! Shu, you pressed the red button again! I told you never to press the red button!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Fine! Take your stupid water! It's gone all weird anyway. It's black, like ink, and it whispers when you bottle it.

win.speaker: player
win.text: It whispers?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Nice things! It says I'm a genius! Which I am! Ugh, forget it! Retreat! Retreat!

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Hah! Bow before the Pilaf Reservoir! That'll be five thousand zeni per sip!

after.text: The river is flowing again. But you are right to worry. Near the dam, the water was dark, and very cold.
I will keep watch over it. My people have suffered from thirst before. I will not let them be poisoned.

quests.title: Pilaf's Evil Elixir
quests.summary: Pilaf is selling bottles of black 'Evil Elixir', and everyone who drinks it turns violent.

brief.text: Travelers on the road have been fighting each other. Neighbors. Brothers. Each one carried a little bottle of black water.
The label says, 'Pilaf's Evil Elixir: Be Your Worst Self Today!' I do not understand it.
So he's bottling the river water.
And whatever is in it is changing people. Find him, and this time, destroy his machine. There is no need to be gentle.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Mountain Road at dusk. Crates of black bottles are stacked up inside a cave.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: You again?! Doesn't matter! I've been drinking my own product, and I feel incredible!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Pilaf, that water is the Malice!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: The water says it came from a place called the Dead Zone! It used to be a mist! Now it's my business! Mai, Shu, combine!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: No! My elixir empire... ruined!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: The water came out of a little crack in the rock. It smelled like an old well. The voice in it never said its name.

win.speaker: player
win.text: What did it want?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: It wanted the whole world to drink it! Even I thought that was too much, and I'm extremely evil!

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Ha ha ha! Have a free sample! Satisfaction guaranteed!

after.text: The Dead Zone. The old monks in the north talk about it. A prison with no way out. And yet, something got out.
I sealed the crack with stones from our temple. But it will not hold forever.

quests.title: Akuman's Devilmite Beam
quests.summary: Namu wants help from Akuman, whose beam only hurts evil hearts. But the Malice has turned him evil too.

brief.text: There is a fighter at Fortuneteller Baba's palace. A devil whose beam only hurts the wicked. I wanted to ask for his help.
With his power, we could test the travelers and find out who carries the Malice. But Akuman has been Corrupted too.
Then we beat him first and ask nicely after.
I would have said it more politely. But yes. I will fight beside you.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Desert at night. Akuman floats above the sand with his pitchfork, glowing violet.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Ohoho! Visitors! Let me look into your hearts. The Devilmite Beam never misses an evil one!

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Akuman. We came here to ask for your help.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Help? I've judged the wicked for centuries. Now the fog says everyone is wicked. Everyone! Isn't that wonderful?

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Then judge me first. I have carried water up this mountain for my village since I was a boy. Find the evil in that.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Ow... ow... So this is what it feels like to get hit by a good heart. It's awful.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Fine, fine, I'll test your water. But listen. The Malice isn't just Hell's filth. There's something else in it. Something older.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Older? What do you mean?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: An old mist that was sealed away for ages. Someone mixed his own poison into Hell's. Clever. I'm almost jealous.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Wicked, wicked, you're all wicked! Devilmite Beam!

after.text: Akuman will check the river at every new moon. A strange ally. But my village has had stranger guests.
You have fought for my people three times, {name}. Now let me teach you how I fight for them. We begin with the Cross Arm Dive.

quests.title: The Stolen Senzu Beans!
quests.summary: Someone stole a bag of senzu beans from Korin's Tower. Yajirobe swears it wasn't him.

brief.text: Hey, you! Patrol! Somebody stole a whole bag of senzu from Korin's Tower, and Korin thinks I did it!
Okay, I ate a few. Four, tops! But the rest got taken by two guys in armor with scouters on.
Frieza's soldiers? Here on Earth?
How should I know? Just get the beans back and we'll split 'em. Well... you can have one.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Desert. Two of Frieza's soldiers are fighting over a little cloth bag.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: These beans heal any wound! Lord Frieza will promote us for sure!

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: The voice in the fog said we'd be officers! No more cleaning the space pods!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Those beans belong to Korin. Hand them over.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Someone saw us! Get rid of them!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: No... my promotion...

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: We were sick of being nobodies. A voice in the mist promised us a new empire. Bigger than Frieza's.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Bigger than Frieza's? Whose empire?

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: It never said. Just that every soldier who died for Frieza would serve a better master. We believed it.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Ha! Your power level is barely worth reading!

after.text: You got 'em back? Great! Huh? There's fewer than I thought... Hey, don't look at me like that!
A new empire, huh? There's always some jerk who wants to rule everything. Whatever. I'm hungry.

quests.title: Vegeta Comes for Yajirobe!
quests.summary: The Vegeta from his first trip to Earth is back, and he wants the guy who cut off his tail. Yajirobe is hiding.

brief.text: Hide me! Vegeta's back! The old one, with the armor and the scouter! He's yelling my name all over the desert!
Years ago I cut his tail off with my sword. I saved everybody! And he's still mad about it!
So you want me to fight Vegeta for you.
Now you're getting it! Oh, and if the moon comes out, don't let him look at it. Trust me.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Desert at night. A full moon is rising, and Vegeta is waiting on a dune.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Where is he? The fat one with the sword! I'll make him pay for my tail!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Yajirobe's not here. You'll have to deal with me.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: You? Don't make me laugh, insect. You're nothing!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: The Malice gave me back my tail. And look up... a full moon! Now see the true power of a Saiyan!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Ugh... beaten by a nobody... even with the full moon!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Something was controlling me. Me, the prince of all Saiyans! I heard it laughing in my head. I'll find it and destroy it!

win.speaker: player
win.text: You'll have to beat me to it.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Hmph. And tell that coward with the sword this isn't over!

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Pathetic. Now go get the fat one for me, and maybe I'll let you live.

after.text: Is he gone? He's really gone? Ha! I knew you could do it. I was watching the whole time... from inside that barrel.

quests.title: Three Vegetas, One Samurai
quests.summary: Yajirobe bragged about cutting Vegeta's tail, and now three Corrupted Vegetas are after him. This time he's coming along.

brief.text: So I was at a noodle stand telling everybody the tail story. Kind of loud. And now there's three Vegetas after me!
Regular Vegeta, Super Saiyan Vegeta, and an even spikier one. And they're all screaming my name!
Then come with me this time.
Aw, fine! But only 'cause Korin says no more senzu if I don't. I'm doing this for the beans!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Desert at noon. Three Vegetas are waiting, all glowing violet.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: So the tail thief finally shows himself. And he brought a bodyguard.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Leave the bodyguard to me. The fat one's been bragging about me for years. He's mine.

intro.speaker: enemy3
intro.text: Enough talk! You're both trash, and I'm taking out the trash!

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: I-I'm not scared! I've got my sword and a full stomach! Let's go!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Tch. Beaten by a rookie and a glutton. If Kakarot hears about this, you're both dead.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: I won't tell him nothin'! ...Unless he buys me lunch.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Garlic Jr. That runt used me as his weapon. Three times over!

win.speaker: player
win.text: Well, he won't get a fourth.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Hmph. And you, samurai... That was a clean cut, back then. I'll admit it. Tell anyone and you die.

lose.speaker: enemy3
lose.text: That's it? This is the swordsman who humiliated a prince? Pathetic!

after.text: Did you hear that? Vegeta said it was a clean cut! Vegeta complimented me! Nobody's gonna believe this!
Okay, I'll train you. Rule one: eat first. Rule two: hit 'em while they're talking. That's pretty much it.

quests.title: Arale and General Blue!
quests.summary: General Blue of the Red Ribbon Army is making houses float around Penguin Village. Arale wants to play tag with him.

brief.text: Ncha! Hiya! Are you the new Patrol person? Cool outfit! I'm Arale!
There's a grumpy blond man in town making houses float with his mind! He's all purple! I asked him to play tag and he yelled at me!
That's General Blue of the Red Ribbon Army. He's dangerous.
Ooh, dangerous tag! That's the best kind! You go first! Ncha!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Penguin Village. Houses are floating above the road.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: This village is a disgrace! No discipline at all! Even the penguins talk!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: General Blue! The Malice has you. Stand down!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: The Red Ribbon Army is finished. But the voice in the mist says I can lead a new army. One that never retreats!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: And I'll start by flattening this ridiculous town! Prepare yourself!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Impossible! Beaten in this town again! What is wrong with this place?!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: That girl with the glasses... where is she? Keep her away from me!

win.speaker: player
win.text: She just wants to play tag.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Tag?! I'd rather face Commander Red! I'm leaving!

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Hmph. Discipline wins. Now, where is that awful little girl?

after.text: Aww, he flew away screaming! Does that mean I won tag? I won! Ncha!
Come back soon, okay? Gatchan and I wanna find a new friend! A really, REALLY big one!

quests.title: The Gentle Giant of Muscle Tower
quests.summary: Arale heard there's a robot living in Muscle Tower. She wants to be his friend, but the Malice has him.

brief.text: Guess what! There's a big robot living in a tower up in the snow! A robot, just like me! We're gonna be best friends!
But people say he's angry and purple now. Maybe he's just lonely! I get lonely when Senbei works all night.
That's Android 8. Hatchan. He's really gentle, normally.
Then let's go give him a hug! You do the fighting part, okay? I'm not good at stopping.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Muscle Tower, in the snow. Hatchan is waiting on the top floor.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Go away! Hatchan hurt people before. Doctor said fight. Now voice says fight. Hatchan doesn't want to fight!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Then don't! You don't have to listen to that voice.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Voice is too loud! It says Goku forgot Hatchan. It says nobody ever comes back for Hatchan!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: That's not true! A girl came all the way from Penguin Village to be your friend!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Hatchan... sorry. Hatchan didn't want to hurt you.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: A girl came? For Hatchan? Hatchan never had a robot friend before.

win.speaker: player
win.text: She's right outside, building a snowman. You'll like her.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: The voice laughed when Hatchan cried. Hatchan doesn't like that voice. Hatchan won't forget it.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Hatchan sorry... Please stay down. Please.

after.text: Hatchan's my best friend now! He let me ride on his shoulders! And he's coming to my wrestling tournament!
Oh, did I forget to tell you? I'm having a wrestling tournament in Penguin Village! You're in it! Ncha!

quests.title: Penguin Village Wrestling Tournament!
quests.summary: Three members of the Ginyu Force signed up for Arale's wrestling tournament. They think it's an invasion.

brief.text: The tournament is on! We've got a ring and snacks, and the sun is the judge! And three funny guys in matching outfits signed up!
They keep doing poses and yelling their names! They say they're gonna conquer the planet! What a cool entrance!
Arale, that's the Ginyu Force. And they're Corrupted.
So they're the bad guys! Every tournament needs bad guys! Get in the ring, {name}! I'll be the announcer!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Penguin Village. Three members of the Ginyu Force are waiting in the ring.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Guldo!

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Burter!

intro.speaker: enemy3
intro.text: Jeice! Together we are the... wait. The Captain and Recoome aren't here! The pose doesn't work with three!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Should we wait for them, or...?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: No! The Ginyu Force never waits! We'll beat you ourselves!

win.speaker: enemy3
win.text: Ugh... that purple power made us stronger, and we still lost.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Nobody's ever been faster than me... The voice promised we'd be the elite of a new empire.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: The Captain got the same offer. He said yes right away. That's the Captain for you.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Where is he now?

win.speaker: enemy3
win.text: Practicing a new pose for the final. He'll be here soon, mate. Better get ready.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Too slow! Nobody's faster than the great Burter!

after.text: That was the best match ever! The sun gave you ten points! He's a really tough judge!
And now Captain Ginyu is coming for the final! I'm so excited! Ncha!

quests.title: Captain Ginyu's Grand Final!
quests.summary: Captain Ginyu and Recoome are here for the final, and Ginyu wants a new body. Arale is your tag partner.

brief.text: It's the final! Captain Ginyu and the big orange guy, Recoome! And I'm your tag partner! Ncha!
We need a team pose! I point at the sky, you point at me, and we both yell 'Ncha!' Perfect!
Be careful. Ginyu can swap bodies with people.
Swap bodies? Like trading lunches? Okay! But I'm keeping my glasses. I can't see a thing without them!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Penguin Village. The grand final is about to start.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: I am Captain Ginyu, leader of the Ginyu Force! Behold the new pose I made for our new empire!

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Recoome! Recoome loves wrestling! Recoome will squeeze you till you pop!

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Ncha! I'm Arale, the strongest girl in Penguin Village! And this is {name}! The coolest!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Enough! Your body will do nicely, robot girl. Body... CHANGE!

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Huh? That tickled. Did something happen? Why do you look so surprised?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: My Body Change didn't work on a robot... I lost with a perfect pose. This is the worst day of my life!

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Recoome... sleepy. That little girl hits harder than Vegeta.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Listen to me. The voice that recruited us has a star. A red star, coming toward this planet. When it gets here, you're all finished.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: A star's coming here? Ooh, maybe I can catch it! Ncha!

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Victory is ours! Recoome, the special pose!

after.text: We won the belt! And it's made of candy! I already ate half! You can have the other half!
Now I'll teach you pro-wrestling! Lesson one: be super strong! Lesson two: be super strong again! Ncha!

quests.title: Namek Burns Again!
quests.summary: Zarbon and Dodoria are burning Namekian villages again, just like during Frieza's invasion.

brief.text: You're from the Patrol? I am Nail, Elder Guru's guardian. Frieza's men are back on Namek, and they're burning our villages.
Zarbon and Dodoria. The same two who came before. My people are being killed all over again.
Do you have to stay at Guru's side?
Last time, I stayed. It was my duty, and I've regretted it ever since. Not this time. Go on ahead. I'll protect the survivors.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Planet Namek. A village is burning, and two of Frieza's men stand in the ruins.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Oh, a visitor. Dodoria, try not to get anything on my cape this time.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Hah! Look at this one, acting brave! I'll squash you just like those Namekian brats!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Not this time. I won't let you hurt anyone else!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: How tiresome. Very well. I'll show you my beautiful side first... and then my ugly one.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: My face... The Malice made me so strong. Without it, I'm...

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Ugh... We didn't come back for Frieza. Some new boss sent us. He talks to us through the mist.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: He promised us every planet Frieza ever conquered. He knew we'd say yes.

win.speaker: player
win.text: And you did?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Of course. That's why he picked us. He picks people who've done it before.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Hahaha! Just like those Namekians! Too easy!

after.text: The villagers are safe. I carried the last child out myself. Thank you, {name}.
Frieza's men, serving a new master... Elder Guru is worried. He keeps dreaming about a red star.

quests.title: Cui's Dirty Deal
quests.summary: Frieza's soldier Cui says he'll tell the Patrol who's behind the Malice, if he gets a pardon and a ship.

brief.text: A soldier named Cui came to the village waving a white flag. He says he knows who's behind the Malice.
He'll only talk to the Patrol. He wants a pardon and a ship. And, as he put it, 'a little respect for once.'
Do you trust him?
I trust that he's scared. A scared man will either tell you the truth or betray you. Keep your guard up.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A hill on Namek. Cui is waiting next to a white flag.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Ah, the Patrol! I'll tell you everything. The one behind all this has eyes everywhere, and his star is...

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Go on. Talk.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Hahaha! You fell for it! There's no deal! He promised me something better than a pardon. He promised me Vegeta!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Revenge on the prince who blew me to pieces! All I had to do was get you out here alone. Sorry, rookie!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Ugh... fine! I give up! Betraying people is a lot harder than Lord Frieza made it look.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Okay, here's the truth. He's been stealing star charts from Frieza's old records. He's tracking a star. The Makyo Star.

win.speaker: player
win.text: What happens when it gets here?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: He gets stronger. I never saw his face. Just a small shadow, and black water where he'd been standing.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Ha! Got you! So do I get my reward now? Hello? Are you there?

after.text: So Cui told the truth in the end. He was too scared not to.
The Makyo Star... Elder Guru said that name once, in his sleep. He told me to forget it. I couldn't.

quests.title: Nail's Rematch with Frieza
quests.summary: Frieza is back on Namek in three forms. Nail lost to him once. This time he wants to win.

brief.text: Frieza is here. Three of him. The form that tore off my arm, and the forms that came after.
Last time, I was only stalling him so Gohan and Krillin could get away. I never fought to win. This time I will.
Then we'll fight to win. Together.
Together. Elder Guru would like that. He always said I fought alone too much.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Planet Namek. Frieza is waiting among the broken rocks.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Oh my. The Namekian who wasted my time. Have you come to stall me again?

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: No. This time I'm here to beat you.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Beat me? Ho ho ho! You know, something in this fog keeps giving me orders. Me! When I'm done here, I'll find it.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: But first, I'll teach you some manners. Don't worry. I'll be gentle... for a moment.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: This is unforgivable! Beaten, and used like a puppet! I don't know which makes me angrier!

win.speaker: player2
win.text: It's over. I stood my ground, and I won. Elder Guru... did you see?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Enjoy it while you can, Namekian. That little toad with the star thinks he can give me orders. When I find him, he's finished.

win.speaker: player
win.text: You'll have to get past me first, Frieza.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Oh, did you fall down? Get up. I'd hate for this to end so soon.

after.text: I fought Frieza and won. I'm not proud. I'm just... relieved. Like I finally finished something.
Train with me, {name}. I'll teach you what I learned fighting Frieza: how to keep standing when you've got nothing left.

quests.title: Bardock's Lost Comrade
quests.summary: Bardock's old teammate Celipa died on Planet Meat. Now she's back from Hell, Corrupted, and she blames him.

brief.text: Patrol, huh? I don't need a babysitter. But there's a woman out past the asteroid belt wearing my old team's armor. Celipa.
She died on Planet Meat with the rest of my team. Dodoria's men killed them while I was knocked out.
Now she's alive, glowing purple, and screaming my name. Go check it out. I'll stay close.
You're not coming?
I can't face her. Not yet. Just go.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Outer Space. Celipa is floating near the wreck of a Saiyan pod.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Bardock sent a kid? Figures. He sent us to Planet Meat too. Said it'd be easy. Said he'd catch up.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: He did go after you. He found you. He's never forgotten.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: He wasn't there! Tora, Borgos, Shugesh, me... We died calling his name! The Malice made me remember every second!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: So I'll start with you. Then Bardock can find out what it's like to wait for help that never comes!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Damn... the rookie hits like a Saiyan.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Tell him... tell him we know he tried. I knew it back then. The Malice turned it into hate.

win.speaker: player
win.text: You could tell him yourself.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: No. Not like this. And tell him something else. In Hell, the Saiyans are talking about a voice that promises a new Planet Vegeta.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Stay down. That's what weaklings are good at.

after.text: She said that? That they know I tried? ...Give me a minute.
I still see things, you know. Ever since that Kanassan hit me. Lately it's a red star, and something small laughing under it.

quests.title: Father and Son! Raditz Runs Wild
quests.summary: Bardock's eldest son Raditz is Corrupted and smashing ships in space. Bardock wants him stopped.

brief.text: Raditz. My eldest. He's out there smashing cargo ships, glowing purple like the rest. Of course he is.
He always wanted to be an elite. He never was. Neither was I, but I didn't whine about it.
You want me to fight your son?
I want you to knock some sense into him. Then I'll have a talk with him. It's been a long time.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Outer Space. Raditz is tearing a cargo ship apart.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Ha ha ha! The fog was right! I AM an elite! Kakarot, Vegeta, Nappa... none of them can look down on me now!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Raditz! Your father's watching.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Father? Bardock? Where?! ...No. Let him watch. Let him finally see how strong I am!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Here's a present for you, rookie! And if that's not enough, there's a full moon right over there!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: I lost? Again? With all that power? Then what was it all for?

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Bardock lands next to his son. For a while, neither of them says a word.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: ...He called me an idiot and patted my head. Like when I was a kid. I hate him... No. I don't.

win.speaker: player
win.text: The voice that gave you that power. What did it want from you?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Nothing yet. That's what scared me. It said it would come to collect when its star rises.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Ha! You see that, Father? Did you see that?!

after.text: Raditz is a lousy fighter and a worse son. But he's still my son. Thanks for not killing him.
His star. My visions. What Celipa heard. It's all the same thing, Patrol. Someone is building a Saiyan army out of the dead.

quests.title: The King of All Saiyans
quests.summary: King Vegeta has come back from Hell to rule again. Bardock wants a word with the king who bowed to Frieza.

brief.text: King Vegeta. The last king of the Saiyans. He bowed to Frieza and handed over his own son.
Now he's back, with purple eyes, gathering dead Saiyans in a crater. He's calling it the new Planet Vegeta.
You don't like him much.
I don't have to like him. I just need him to stop recruiting my dead friends. Let's go pay His Majesty a visit.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A ruined Earth. King Vegeta sits on a throne made of broken armor.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Bardock. The low-class soldier who attacked Frieza alone. I remember you. You embarrassed me.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: And you bowed to him. Right before he blew up our planet, you bowed. I remember that too.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: I bowed to protect my people! And I failed. Now a voice offers me a planet no one can destroy. Kneel, and I'll forgive you.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: I've never knelt to anybody, and I'm not starting with a dead king. {name}, let's take his crown!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Enough... The Malice is gone, but the shame is still here. It always will be.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Frieza fooled you. He fooled all of us. But some of us didn't bow.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: My son... I gave him to Frieza when he was a child. The Malice showed me what he's become. A wizard's mark on his forehead.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Bardock... find him. Free him. I have no right to ask you. But I'm asking.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Kneel, low-class. Every Saiyan kneels to his king in the end.

after.text: Never thought I'd take an order from that man. Never thought I'd hear him ask anyone for anything, either.

quests.title: King Vegeta and the Majin Prince
quests.summary: King Vegeta's son is back with Babidi's mark, along with a Super Saiyan 4 Vegeta. The king wants to fight them himself.

brief.text: Found the prince. Two of him. One's got Babidi's M on his forehead. The other's from the future, with red fur.
King Vegeta's going in with you. Yeah, really. He came out of Hell on his own to do this. Give him some credit.
And you?
I'm keeping watch. Something big has been circling this fight. It's not Garlic Jr. I don't think even he can control it.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The World Tournament stage at sunset. Majin Vegeta is waiting in the ring.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Father. Of all people. You sold me to Frieza, and now you're here to lecture me?

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: I'm here to fight you. That's the only way our family ever talked.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Hmph. Ancient history. I'm the strongest Vegeta there is. Neither of you can touch me.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: The Malice lets me be as cruel as I really am. No more pretending. No more family. Just my pride!

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Then I'll show you what pride is worth. Patroller, stay by my side. I won't fail my son twice.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: ...Father. You fought for me. You never did that. Not once.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: I was a fool and a coward. I knelt to Frieza. You never did. Be better than me, son. You already are.

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Tch. What a sappy scene. ...By the way, the Malice isn't Garlic's anymore. Something underneath broke loose. I felt it.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Kakarot hears nothing about this. Understood?

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: You see, Father? This is what you made. Be proud.

after.text: I watched from the ridge. The king put his hand on the prince's head, and the prince let him. Never thought I'd see that.
There's one more fight left, Patrol. Mine. Come find me when you're ready.

quests.title: Bardock vs. Frieza: Final Revenge!
quests.summary: Mecha Frieza and King Cold have come back through the Malice. Bardock has waited his whole life for this fight.

brief.text: Mecha Frieza and his father, King Cold. The ones who decided the Saiyans had to go. They're out there.
I went after Frieza once, all by myself. I couldn't even scratch him. I had to watch my planet blow up.
This time I've got a partner. Don't make me regret saying that.
For Celipa. For Tora. For Planet Vegeta.
...Yeah. For them. Let's go.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Outer Space. King Cold and Mecha Frieza wait on the wreck of Frieza's ship.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: A Saiyan? Look, Frieza, a Saiyan. I thought we got rid of all of them.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Father, that's Bardock. The monkey who tried to stop me with a little ball of light. I never forgot his face.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Good. Then you'll know who beat you.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: The Malice gave us our bodies back, monkey. It gave us everything. Except a reason to be afraid of you.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Then I'll give you one! This is for all of us, Frieza!

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Again... beaten by a Saiyan... again! Those filthy monkeys!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: No one controls the Malice now. It just takes whatever monster is closest. And this time, that was us.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Ha... Ha ha ha! Celipa, you see that? Tora? I got 'em. I finally got 'em!

win.speaker: player
win.text: Bardock... are you crying?

win.speaker: player2
win.text: It's space dust. Shut up, Patrol. ...Thanks.

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Just like Planet Vegeta. Just like your precious little world. Gone.

after.text: My visions stopped. First time in years. No red star, no laughing, no burning planets. Just quiet.
I'll train you, {name}. Low-class style. You don't win because you were born strong. You win because you never give up.

0.greet: Hey! Wanna learn the Kaio-ken? King Kai taught me! It hurts a lot at first, but it makes you way stronger!
0.done: That's all I've got! Man, you're tough. Let's spar again tomorrow, okay?

1.greet: On the way to Namek, I trained at a hundred times Earth's gravity! We'll start with something lighter. Like fifty!
1.done: You got it! And if you ever need a Spirit Bomb, just ask everybody for a little energy. They'll help!

2.greet: I don't like this form much. It came from being angry. If you learn it, you have to stay in control. That's the hard part.
2.done: You stayed calm the whole time. Better than I did on Namek. I'm proud of you!

11.greet: Grandpa said you always bow before a fight! So bow! Okay, now let's fight!
11.done: Wow, you learned all my moves! Wanna go fishing? I'm really hungry!

12.greet: GRRRAAAHH! (The Great Ape pounds the ground and waits. It wants you to roar back.)
12.done: Grrr... (The Great Ape thumps its chest, lies down and falls asleep. The lessons are over.)

13.greet: Mr. Piccolo left me alone in the wild for six months. I'll teach you what I learned! Mostly how to survive.
13.done: You did great! Um, please don't tell my mom I taught you the Masenko. She wants me to study.

14.greet: Dad and I trained in the Time Chamber for a year. He says I'm stronger than him now. I'm still not sure.
14.done: That's everything I know. Just promise me one thing: only fight when you really have to.

15.greet: Dad and I stayed Super Saiyan all day, every day, until it felt normal. That's the trick. Let's try it.
15.done: You can stay Super Saiyan without straining now. Dad would say you're ready for anything!

16.greet: This power came out when I lost control against Cell. I want you to learn it without the anger. It's harder, but it's right.
16.done: You never let the anger take over. I wish I'd done that against Cell.

24.greet: Stand up. Again. A Namekian warrior isn't judged by how hard he hits, but by how long he stays standing.
24.done: You aren't a Namekian, but you fight to protect others like one. Guru would be pleased.

25.greet: Me? A master? Wow, okay! Rule one: use the Solar Flare first. Rule two: always duck. Seriously, always.
25.done: You learned the Destructo Disc! Just be careful where you throw it, okay? It cuts through anything.

26.greet: The Wolf Fang Fist is all about rhythm. Hah! Hah! Hah! Fight like a wolf: fast, low and fierce!
26.done: You're a natural! Okay, maybe better than me. Don't tell Krillin, all right?

27.greet: The Crane School taught me to kill. Master Roshi taught me why I shouldn't. I'll teach you both. The choice is yours.
27.done: The Neo Tri-Beam takes everything you have. Only use it to protect someone who matters.

28.greet: I can't punch very hard. So I stop people from moving instead! Telekinesis takes a lot of focus.
28.done: You did it! Tien says you're a good student. He doesn't say that about anyone. Except me!

29.greet: You want the Prince of all Saiyans to train you? Fine. Keep up, insect. I won't slow down for you.
29.done: Hmph. You're not completely worthless anymore. Don't let it go to your head.

30.greet: Under the full moon, a Saiyan shows his true form. Try not to get crushed while you learn.
30.done: Enough. You survived my true form. Not many can say that.

34.greet: I don't train students. I train rivals. If you're not trying to surpass me, get out of my sight.
34.done: Tch. You've learned it all. Now train until you can beat me. Then I'll beat you.

35.greet: A Super Saiyan's power means nothing without control. Every blast, every step. Again! Wrong! Again!
35.done: Perfect. ...Don't make me say it twice.

36.greet: Kakarot thinks fighting is a game. Not me. Power comes from hard work, every single day. Start working.
36.done: You've worked hard. You've earned every technique I have. Now stop staring at me.

37.greet: I let Babidi into my head just so I could fight Kakarot as my old self. Don't make the same mistake. Watch.
37.done: You've seen the worst of me, and you trained anyway. The last lesson was Final Explosion. I hope you never need it.

38.greet: This form took a machine, my tail and Bulma's genius. All you have to do is survive me. That's the hard part.
38.done: Final Shine Attack. Remember that feeling. That's what it means to fight like a prince.

60.greet: Training? Ugh, fine. But we eat first, and you're paying. Rule number one: never fight on an empty stomach.
60.done: That's everything I know. Now let's go eat. You're still paying.

66.greet: The Turtle School way: work hard, study well, eat and rest plenty, and enjoy life! Hohoho!
66.done: You've mastered the original Kamehameha! It took me fifty years to create it. Now, uh... got any magazines?

67.greet: When the shirt comes off, I'm serious! Don't laugh. I once blew up the moon with this!
67.done: That's the MAX POWER Kamehameha! Now help me get my shirt back on... Ow, my back!

68.greet: Being gentle is part of martial arts too. A strong man who isn't kind has only learned half of it. Shall we begin?
68.done: You fight with a kind heart. So did Goku, even as a little boy. Thank you for letting an old man teach again.

69.greet: I fought in the World Tournament to bring water to my village. I will teach you to fight for others, not for yourself.
69.done: The Cross Arm Dive is yours now. Use it to help people who need it.

70.greet: Hatchan teach you! Hatchan is strong, but Hatchan is careful too. You learn careful first, okay?
70.done: You learned everything! Hatchan happy! Hatchan will tell Goku how good you are!

71.greet: I am the King of all Saiyans. I may be dead, but I am still king. You will show me respect while I teach you.
71.done: You fight like a true Saiyan warrior. Few have ever earned praise from a king.

72.greet: A royal Great Ape is no mindless beast. It is a king at his full power. Watch closely.
72.done: Enough. Now you know what it means to fight under the full moon.

73.greet: No fancy stances, no secret moves. You hit, you get hit, you get back up. That's how we fight. Ready?
73.done: That's all of it. Now go change somebody's future. I couldn't change mine.

74.greet: Most Saiyans lose their minds as a Great Ape. I'll teach you to keep yours. Let's go.
74.done: You kept your head the whole time. Not bad, kid. Most Saiyans can't do that.

75.greet: Bardock's team fights dirty and fights together. Today you're learning the dirty part. Let's go!
75.done: Not bad, kid. You'd have fit right in with our crew.

76.greet: Great Ape training. Smash the enemy, not me. Got it?
76.done: You'd have made a fine Saiyan. Loud, stubborn and always hungry. Tora would've liked you.

77.greet: I'm a top-class warrior! I can teach you much more than Kakarot ever could. Watch carefully!
77.done: You've mastered my techniques. Hmph. Maybe I'm not such a bad teacher after all.

78.greet: Any Saiyan can transform. Not every Saiyan can aim. Let's work on that.
78.done: Good. Now you know the power of the moon. Too bad the people on Earth keep destroying theirs.

79.greet: Kkkee! Kkkehehe! (The Saibaman points at you, then at itself, then acts out a big explosion.)
79.done: Kkkeee! (The Saibaman hops up and down. It looks happy with you.)

80.greet: Training? Ha! Okay. Rule one: the big guy wins. Rule two: if the big guy loses, hit harder!
80.done: Hey, you learned all of it! Vegeta never thought I'd be a good teacher. Guess he was wrong!

81.greet: Being a Great Ape is easy. You get big, and you smash stuff. Why does everybody make it so complicated?
81.done: You smashed everything! Perfect! Now let's go throw some mountains around!

82.greet: Beauty first, then power. An ugly victory is still a disgrace. Now, stand up straight.
82.done: Elegant. Truly. You may tell everyone that I trained you.

83.greet: I hate this form. It's hideous. But it's also very, very strong. Learn it, and never let me see you enjoy it.
83.done: Yes, yes, you've learned it all. Now go away. I need to change back.

84.greet: Hah! You want to learn from me? Then you'd better like pain. Yours, not mine!
84.done: Ugh, you learned it all. Fine. Get lost before I change my mind.

85.greet: Vegeta thinks he's so great. Ha! I'll show you how a real member of Frieza's army fights. Watch closely!
85.done: You've got all my moves! Now go beat Vegeta for me. Ha ha!

86.greet: Lesson one: the pose. Lesson two: the pose. Lesson three: still the pose! After that, we fight!
86.done: Magnificent! Your pose is almost as good as mine! You're an honorary member of the Ginyu Force!

87.greet: Recoome will teach you! First, the Recoome Fighting Pose! No, bigger! BIGGER!
87.done: You learned the Recoome Eraser Gun! Recoome is so proud! Come here, Recoome will give you a big hug!

88.greet: Speed is everything, and I'm the fastest in the universe. So try not to blink.
88.done: You're fast. Almost as fast as me. Almost! Don't get cocky.

89.greet: Right then! The Crusher Ball is all in the wrist. And the attitude. Mostly the attitude!
89.done: Brilliant! You've got it all, mate. Not bad for a rookie!

90.greet: I can stop time! But only while I hold my breath. So the lessons will be very short.
90.done: You learned everything! Wow. Nobody ever finishes my lessons. They usually just leave.

91.greet: You wish to learn from me? How flattering. Very well. Do try not to die in the first lesson.
91.done: You've learned all I care to teach in this form. Consider yourself lucky. Most of my students are dead.

92.greet: Ah, my second form. Bigger, and much stronger. Let's see how long you last.
92.done: Splendid. Not many can say they survived training with me.

93.greet: Even I find this form ugly. But fear is a weapon, and I know exactly how to use it. Watch.
93.done: Hmph. You barely flinched. How annoying. Very well, you've learned it all.

96.greet: That Saiyan brat cut me to pieces. Now I'm half machine, and I want revenge. Watch and learn.
96.done: There. Every lesson. Remember this: I always come back. Always.

97.greet: Kneel. No? Hmph. Then stand, and learn how a true king fights.
97.done: You fight with almost royal grace. My sons could have learned something from you.

98.greet: Frieza Force training! Step one: check their power level. Step two: report it. Step three: run if it's too high!
98.done: You passed! Better than me. I never got step three right.

99.greet: They only ever taught us one special move. The Life-Risking Blow. It's all in the name. Ready?
99.done: That's all Frieza's army ever taught me. Most of us didn't last very long.

148.greet: My fee is usually very high. For you, I'll make an exception. We start with the Dodon Ray. Point your finger, like this.
148.done: Hmph. You'd make a decent assassin. Not as good as me, of course.

149.greet: This metal body taught me patience. And how to hold a grudge. You'll learn the Hidden Blade too.
149.done: You've learned it all. Now go. And if you see Goku, tell him I'm coming for him.

150.greet: Discipline! Posture! Mind over matter! And stay away from that girl with the glasses!
150.done: You have the makings of a fine soldier. Now, if you'll excuse me, I'm getting out of this crazy village.

151.greet: My Devilmite Beam only hurts people with evil in their hearts. Let's see how much it hurts you. Hohoho!
151.done: My beam barely touched you! How disappointing. Well, you must have a pure heart. Off you go.

152.greet: Learn from the future ruler of the world? Ha! Fine. But you have to polish the robot afterward.
152.done: You learned everything! Now swear loyalty to Emperor Pilaf! ...No? Nobody ever does!

153.greet: Mai! Shu! Combine! Behold our ultimate machine! You're learning from the best there is!
153.done: You finished the course! Good, because we're almost out of missiles. Now go away!

154.greet: The Demon King's son doesn't train anyone gently. I'll teach you the way I learned. You survive, or you don't.
154.done: You survived every lesson. My father would have killed you for your nerve. I'll let you live.

155.greet: I am the Demon King Piccolo. Kings don't teach, they give orders. So I order you to learn. Begin!
155.done: You have learned the Demon King's arts. Use them to rule, or be ruled.

156.greet: Ncha! Training time! First we run around the whole planet! Just kidding! Let's play!
156.done: You learned all my moves! Now you're the second strongest in Penguin Village! Ncha!

157.greet: Don't think I'll go easy on you just because you're in the Patrol! I raised two Saiyans! Now, fighting stance!
157.done: You're done! Now go eat something. You're way too skinny!
